id: # New Game Plus - Renewed perks: hidden (npc_only) skills on the player bought at Legacy Station. With Second-in-Command enabled the code removes npc_only so they show on its Non-Executive Skills page.

description: +10% cargo, fuel and crew capacity on every ship.
author: Legacy Station

description: +1 to the highest burn level that counts as moving slowly.

description: +1 maximum burn level for the fleet.
author: Legacy Station
